skill: Solving a problem and agreeing on a solution

words.def: full of energetic activity; lively and busy
words.ex: The {bustling} market was packed with shoppers and sellers.

words.def: only available at a certain time of year
words.ex: I always look for {seasonal} fruit at the market.

words.def: to keep or sell a supply of something
words.ex: That stall {stocks} about twelve types of olive oil.

words.def: cooked food sold in the open air, ready to eat
words.ex: The best {street food} I ever had was at a night market.

words.def: a person who buys and sells goods, especially at a market
words.ex: The {trader} arranged colourful pyramids of fruit to attract customers.

words.def: much too expensive; far more than is fair
words.ex: The tourist market was {extortionate}: a small bag of nuts cost ten euros.

words.def: to make an effort to find something specific
words.ex: She always {seeks out} the stall with the best chillies.

words.def: a range of things to choose from
words.ex: This market has a wonderful {selection} of cheeses.
